{{Top|leg}}
A '''Neural stunner''' was a weapon that emitted a specially tuned electric shock into a beings [[nervous system]], temporarily rendering them paralyzed.<ref name="som">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' </ref>

These weapons were used by the [[Pawn]]s of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]] to subdue their chosen captives before they underwent transformation into Pawns.<ref name="som" />

Neural stunners, [[sub-q injector]]s, and [[shock panel]]s were among the many security measures that [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] had installed his ship, the ''[[Hound's Tooth/Legends|Hound's Tooth]]''.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
